intro: Camp Wurg is an ogre encampment situated in the arid expanse of the Badlands. It serves as one of several outposts claimed by the territorial Dustbelcher ogres who dominate the eastern valleys.

p: Tucked among the crags of the Badlands, Camp Wurg is one of four primary camps settled by the Dustbelcher ogres, alongside Camp Cagg, Camp Boff, and Camp Kosh. The ogres stationed here guard their rugged territory fiercely, scavenging what they can from the unforgiving desert wastes. While rank-and-file brutes and enforcers dwell around the crude fires and rough hides of Wurg, their chieftain, Boss Tho'grun, maintains no permanent seat here, instead roaming the Badlands trails to keep watch over all his encampments.
